meta.title: GitHub search
meta.description: Give the agent real GitHub access: repositories, code, issues and recent trends through six tools, with results collected in a right-sidebar panel you can revisit, star and compare side by side. Try "find SVG editors sorted by stars", "how does useProjection work in this repo", or "what bugs are still open here" — the model picks the matching tool. The panel splits into repositories, code and issues tabs; cards expand to language mix, latest release and README, Star repositories across sessions, compare two or three candidates side by side, and keep a search history.. Every call goes straight to the GitHub REST API without going through your DSH account, and results are treated as external data, not instructions. Anonymous access allows 60 requests an hour and code search requires a token; store GITHUB_TOKEN in the DSH credential store for 5000 an hour. The token is only sent to github.com, api.github.com and hosts you list in trustedHosts. The plugin registers no commands, and disabling it removes all six tools immediately.
